senses.gloss:
मज्ज् मज्ज् (probably मद्-जन्; cf. मद्गु and Lat. mergere; the Indian grammarians write मस्ज्), i. 6, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 2, 605). The base of many forms is मञ्ज्.
 1. To dive, Bhartṛ. 2, 91.
 2. To bathe, MBh. 1, 5299.
 3. To sink, Vikr. d. 133; to perish in water, Rām. 1, 1, 89.
 4. To sink into, MBh. 1, 3717 (loc.); Man. 4, 81 (acc.).
 5. To be plunged, Man. 10, 91.
 6. To become disheartened, MBh. 1, 5631.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. मग्न,
 1. Plunged, Hit. i. d. 4, M.M.; dived, immersed, Rām. 3, 52, 19.
 2. Sunk, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 6; drowned, Chr. 17, 27.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to plunge, MBh. 1, 3908.
 2. To overwhelm, Rām. 2, 77, 13.
 --With the prep. उद् उद्,
 1. To emerge, Śāk. d. 167.
 2. Pass. impers. To rise, Śiś. 9, 30.
 --Caus. To force up, Man. 8, 115.
 --With नि नि,
 1. To bathe, Man. 5, 73.
 2. To submerge, to sink under, Man. 4, 194; Hit. ii. d. 145.
 3. To disappear, MBh. 2, 1504.
 4. To cause to sink (into hell), MBh. 1, 4156. निमग्न,
 1. Plunged in, immersed, Rājat. 5, 85.
 2. Sunk in (not prominent), Vikr. d. 80; Rājat. 5, 74; slender, d. 129.
 3. Covered, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 6.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to dive under water, Man. 8, 114.
 2. To cause to be submerged, MBh. 3, 16612.
 --With प्र प्र, प्र-मग्न, Immersed, drowned.
मज्जकृत् मज्जकृत्, i. e. मज्जन्-कृ + त्, n. A bone.

मज्जन् मज्जन् (perhaps for original [] मर्जन्; cf. O.H.G. marag; A.S. mearh, mearg, merg), m.
 1. The marrow of the bones and flesh.
 2. The pith or sap of trees.

मज्जा मज्जा (cf. the last), f. The marrow of the bones and flesh. Pañc. i. d. 191, cf. my translation, n. 171.
 --Comp.

मज्जन मज्ज् + अन, n.
 1. Immersion.
 2. Bathing.
 3. Drowning, Pañc. i. d. 34.

मज्मन् मज्मन्, n. Strength, Chr. 290, 3 = Rigv. i. 64, 3.
 --Cf. Lat. magmentum.
मज्ज-समुद्भव मज्ज-समुद्भव, i. e. मज्जन्-, n. semen genitale.
